diagnostic: Read only already generated summaries/cells and saved scalar scores. Check checkpoint and array hashes and matched cohort/trace identity. Compute between-forecast donor and cell energy distances. Use mixture energy identities at the one registered weight to estimate scores; no held-out target arrays, new generation or training. U-statistic finite-sample and reservoir estimates are not actual fixed-mask native ensemble results.
scope: 100percent GAN-generated pure ensemble, distinguished from one ParticleGAN model and from the prior PG/real-resampling hybrid. Both parent models used the native optimized BISPF API. This adds no fourth trainer family or auxiliary loss.
